diagnostics.message:
[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
delete_http_settings removes an Application Gateway HTTP setting that can reference a probe; it should be ordered before delete_probe so the probe is not removed while still in use. Add an explicit dependency from delete_http_settings to delete_probe.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
HTTP settings can reference probes, so the HTTP-settings delete action should run before the probe delete action. Make the HTTP-settings deletion node depend on the probe deletion node so Terraform destroys the settings first.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
HTTP settings can reference probes, so their deletion must complete before the probe is deleted. Add the dependency in this direction; a dependency from probe deletion to HTTP-settings deletion would reverse the required destroy order.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
delete_frontend_port should be ordered after delete_http_listener cleanup because the listener uses the frontend port; otherwise the port may be removed while the listener still references it. Add an explicit dependency from delete_frontend_port to delete_http_listener.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The frontend port deletion action should wait until HTTP listeners that use the port have been deleted.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
Frontend ports used by HTTP listeners must not be removed until those listeners have been deleted. The frontend-port deletion currently has no ordering dependency on listener deletion.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The probe deletion action should wait until HTTP settings that may reference the probe have been deleted; otherwise Azure may reject or retain the referenced probe.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The probe must be removed only after HTTP settings that may reference it are removed; otherwise deleting the probe can leave the Application Gateway configuration referencing a missing probe. Make the probe deletion depend on the HTTP settings deletion.
